score.scope: Exact normalized values within each completely annotated selected input passage. Instances match on values and sorted unique passage IDs, independently of quote offsets. Claim IDs are ignored; semantic duplicates within a passage collapse and are counted. Grounding additionally requires the entire independently reviewed supporting span. These exposed development scores are not held-out or broad-corpus quality.
